name: The Klinique Medical Clinic Public Company Limited
summary: The Klinique Medical Clinic Public Company Limited, operating from its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand, offers a comprehensive suite of services encompassing skin care, cosmetic surgery, and holistic health solutions. Their extensive portfolio of treatments includes a variety of aesthetic and medical procedures. These range from facial rejuvenation and contouring options like facelifts, dermal fillers, and fat-dissolving injections, to body sculpting using "shape up" treatments. The clinic also specializes in advanced dermatological care for issues such as acne and acne scars, alongside general skin enhancement therapies like laser hair removal, targeted skin injections, Mesoface, and meso treatments. Furthermore, they perform specialized surgical interventions for the nose, eyes, and other facial areas.
